description: Readiness-verdict eval for the quote-prep clerk (runQuotePrep). Baseline gate for the T6 readiness/escalation changes — see docs/EVAL_QUOTE_PREP_BRIEF.md. Runs via scripts/eval-quote-prep.ts, NOT eval-comms. Fixtures are self-contained: photo/video evidence rides as bracketed captions plus the agent's own on-thread descriptions of what the media showed, mirroring how the real threads read. Drama block +4477009008xx is exclusive to this suite. NOTE: quote-prep cases live under quotePrepCases (not cases) so scripts/eval-comms.ts, which flat-maps .cases from every JSON in eval-cases/, ignores this file entirely; cases stays [] on purpose.

lines.description: Cut and fit roller blind in twin window recess

thread.text: We need a roller blind cut to size and fitted with a bracket in the recess of a window.
Hi Rebecca, thanks for getting in touch. Is it OK if we give you a quick call to run through what you need? Or just reply here with the details and we will price it up.
Thanks for your message! It's for putting up a roller blind in the recess. The roller blind needs to be cut to size. It needs to be attached with a bracket (which comes with the roller blind).
Thanks Rebecca, that's helpful. Could you send a quick photo of the window recess so I can see the size and shape we're working with?
I'll send that when I'm home. The roller blind width is 183cm, but it's a few cm too wide to fit in the recess.
[photo] The recess. It would go across both windows
There are paper blinds already up which we would remove
[photo] The blackout roller blind, still boxed up
Thanks Rebecca, that's really clear, the recess with the two windows and the blackout blind still boxed up. Just need your postcode and I'll get this priced up for you.
NG2 3EW
Perfect, got everything I need now. I'll get this priced up and sent over to you shortly.
We'll cut and fit your roller blind to the recess in one quick visit. Here's the full breakdown so you can see exactly what's included, and pick a slot: https://handyservices.app/quote/evqp801a

Thanks so much for this! I've seen that it might be cheaper to install multiple blinds at once, so I've ordered some more and will be back in touch when I've got them to get an updated quote with some added extras. I hope that makes sense?
Good shout, doing them together often works out better value. Once the new blinds are in, send me some photos of those windows and I'll get a combined quote sorted for you.
Hi again, I've got the new blinds, pictures to follow:
[photo] Second window recess with the new blind in its box on the sill
[photo] Third window recess with the other new blind
Both to be adjusted in width and fitted inside the recess. Paper blinds will be removed beforehand.
Also our shower drips:
[photo] The shower, it has a big rain head and a smaller handheld head. I think the drip always comes from the smaller head
Please could you send over a combined quote and possible availability? Thanks!

Morning Rebecca, thanks for these, really clear on both windows. I'm getting a combined quote sorted for all three blinds together now. On the shower, could you send a quick video of where it's dripping from?
[video] Here you go, you can see it dripping constantly from the smaller of the two heads

Thanks Rebecca, that's clear, looks like it's coming from the smaller shower head. I've got everything I need now, the three blinds and the shower drip. I'll get a combined quote sorted for the lot and back to you shortly with dates to pick from.
Quick one on the shower so we can price it right: is it a mixer shower, where one control switches the water between the big head and the small head?
Yes that's right, you twist the ring on the bar and it switches between the two heads
Perfect, that's everything we need on the shower too. Combined quote on its way shortly.

calls.jobSummary: Guttering and repointing issue with water leak and black mould. Customer to send video/photos; urgent; callback promised
calls.transcription:
Agent: Hi Carolyne, it's Handy Services, you asked about brick pointing and guttering?
Carolyne: Yes hi, it's my dad's house, an ex-council semi. When it rains water pours over a ledge or the gutter at the front and runs straight down the wall, and now it's coming into the house. There's black mould appearing on the bedroom wall inside.
Agent: OK, so water overflowing at the top somewhere and getting in above the bedroom window?
Carolyne: I think so. I don't know if the gutter is blocked or if it's the downpipe, or if it's the brickwork itself, there's a crack up there. I'm not great with heights so I haven't been up to look.
Agent: Understood. Could you send over some photos of the front of the house and that area above the window when you're next there?
Carolyne: Yes, I'll be over tonight, I'll send pictures then. It needs sorting quickly, my dad lives there and he's not great on his feet.
Agent: Of course, send those over and we'll get it moving tonight.

Looks like it could do with some repointing in that area, we will confirm properly once we have had a proper look. We will check the guttering while we are at it too.
